div.div: Result: new chart, old code. Knowledge → Rebuild index failed with "pgvector is not installed", because 5b1e709 has no enable_vector(), and bge-m3 got no traffic. It was found the next day. With MK4_DEPLOY true, the deploy job would have synced and restarted onto 982dd05 at about 11:40.

text.tspan: Result: new chart, old code. Knowledge → Rebuild index failed with "pgvector is not installed", because 5b1e709 has no enable_vector(), and bge-m3 got no traffic. It was found the next
day. With MK4_DEPLOY true, the deploy job would have synced and restarted onto 982dd05 at about 11:40.
